name: Instagram Creators Engaging Content Best Practices

engagement_definition.rule: Create content that earns meaningful interactions rather than generic engagement bait.

trial_reels.profile_visibility: not shown on profile or to followers during trial
trial_reels.rule: Use trial Reels to test new concepts, characters and styles before wider distribution when the account is eligible.

format_diversification.rule: Use a mix of formats instead of repeating one format automatically; choose format based on the message, target and objective.

creative_effects.rule: Use creative effects only when they improve storytelling, clarity or interaction.

audio.rights_rule: Use only audio you are licensed or otherwise permitted to use.
audio.purpose: Use music and sound to create atmosphere, meaning or pacing; never as decoration only.

reels_best_practices.rule: Reels must capture attention immediately, remain understandable without sound, and be built to create natural sharing and conversation.
